_comentario: Saludos variables de la pantalla Oraciones (5.6), ahora bilingües y personalizables. Estructura: <idioma> -> {generic, named, <franja>, <franja>_named}. Las listas *named usan {name} (apodo de config/settings.json); si no hay apodo registrado solo se usan las listas sin nombre (core/greetings.py, nunca un {name} vacío en pantalla). Franjas: morning 6-12h, afternoon 12-19h, evening 19-6h. Las frases en inglés son naturales, no traducciones literales.

evening_named: Hola {name}, cuéntame cómo te fue hoy

generic: Hi! What would you like to tell me today?
What do you want to say?
I'm here for you — what's up?
named: Hi {name}, what would you like to tell me today?
What do you want to tell me, {name}?
I'm here for you, {name} — what's up?
morning: Good morning! What would you like to tell me?
morning_named: Good morning, {name}! What would you like to tell me?
Hi {name}, how did you wake up today?
afternoon_named: Good afternoon, {name}! What did you do today?
Hi {name}, how is your afternoon going?
evening: Good evening! What do you want to tell me?
evening_named: Good evening, {name}! How was your day?
Hi {name}, tell me about your day
